principle: Use the existing outcome endpoint; do not create a parallel public routing API.

transaction: Resolve and verify the source instance and its owner.
Reject PUBLIC_DEMO/SANDBOX and non-LIVE source contexts without writing.
Validate body and strip any fields outside the allowlist.
Insert or replay one immutable outcome event by idempotency scope.
Call decideRoute() using the structured facts and existing RouteRule.
Persist the RouteDecision in the same transaction or fail closed.
Return the saved outcome event and decision; never return client-only facts.

statuses.200: Idempotent replay of an existing result
statuses.403: No entitlement/product grant, no ownership, or sandbox/live boundary violation
statuses.404: Source instance or track not found
statuses.409: Correction requested after downstream outcome was consumed
statuses.422: Outcome is structurally valid but cannot satisfy the selected RouteRule
statuses.503: Production repository is unavailable or unconfigured

forbiddenEndpoints: No GET endpoint that exposes outcome history across users
No public POST /api/v1/system-actions/a3-008 that accepts a user id from the client
No endpoint that accepts name, phone, email, message text, transcript or free text note
